limits: All-state issue/PR titles and bodies were enumerated; detailed discussions/patches were inspected for selected candidates, not every thread.
Comment search is keyword-index based. No direct match is a bounded search outcome, not proof of novelty.
Merged/static coverage, open-PR coverage, and local runtime validation are different fields.
Benchmark/grading examples and introducing/refactoring PRs are not automatically treated as production bug reports.
Original AST dispositions and attachment NOT_RUN states are preserved.
